name: Ubatsume Tae
source:
3rd year high school student. A 'Nekomata' cat youkai.
A good friend of the protagonist and [url=/c44618]Heita[/url].
A cheerful and fun girl, but she's considered creepy when her eyes glow in the dark.
Because she's a cat and he's a mouse she doesn't get along well with [url=/c44613]Soujirou[/url].
